description:
Designed and built by Ti Cycles.Made just for you.
Designed by us, made for you.
Handcrafting the highest quality steel materials into your ultimate bicycle. From an initial consultation through the processes of design, fabrication, alignment and finishing, Ti Cycles' attention to detail produces consistently high performing, responsive bicycles.
Any Discipline
Ti Cycles Fabrication brings 35+ years of experience designing, building, and riding virtually every style of the modern cycle. We straddle the fence between designing high-performance refined versions of the classics, and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Applying expert knowledge and precision craftsmanship to state-of-the-art materials, the professionals at Ti Cycles Fabrication build each custom frame with one goal in mind: to deliver the ultimate ride.
Why Go Custom?
No two cyclists are identical and Ti Cycles can design and build a bike that fits your physique, riding style, and intended purposes. Commuting, competing, riding for fitness and fun, bombing down a trail hopping over rocks and roots; each cyclist has specific needs for his or her bike. With this in mind, Ti Cycles draws on decades of frame building, fitting, coaching, racing and pleasure cycling experience to design bicycles that meet each individual's needs.
Each custom frame starts with a professional fitting by Ti Cycles in our Portland workshop. (We also use fit data provided by you or another fitter if you’re not local.) The initial design is fine-tuned through builder/rider discussions about riding style, performance expectations, intended uses, and comfort. Ti Cycles translates this into a frame design that serves the rider, allowing them to pedal efficiently and enjoy the ride.
Steel Frames -- include powder coating finish, seatpost clamp, and your choice of decal color.
All Frames -- include a component build consultation and professional fitting by Ti Cycles in our Portland shop. Customers are responsible for shipping/transportation.
Materials
Ti Cycles' Chrome-Moly frames are built with the same uncompromising attention to detail as our flagship titanium bikes. Today's alloys allow for a high degree of fine tuning and performance.
﻿Lifetime Durability
All custom frames, titanium and steel, are backed by a lifetime repair/replace warranty against defects in materials or workmanship for the original owner.
